finding.claim: Step 5 says the push must come first because 'the action change must be on GitHub first'. Onboarding changes no action: the lab-auth and openviking-sync actions are already on origin/main. The real reasons to push first are that the pinned SHA must exist on GitHub and main should match what was applied. Reword the sentence.

fixes.change: Asks which folders to sync (default docs and .okf), drops folders from the template and filters on both; gives the real reason to push before pinning; says to add the caller in key order. Also makes each step-4 block one self-contained shell call.
